scenes.script: An onion does not want to make you cry. It only wants to stop being eaten.
When your knife breaks its cells, two things that were kept safely apart mix together.
In seconds they form a gas, and the gas floats up to your eyes.
Your eyes feel the sting, so they make tears to wash it away. That is all crying over an onion is.
So chill the onion first, and use a sharp knife. Cold slows the gas, and a clean cut breaks far fewer cells.
